entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unrecognized type of range variable in find all references #78631
  • Source generatior `GlobalOptions` received by exposing `CompilerVisibleProperty` are whitespace sensitive and dont support multiple values #78630
  • `BoundBinaryOperator.Method` is not a binary operator symbol for node created by `BindDynamicBinaryOperator` #78628
  • Syntax error knocks out compiler error recovery leading to poor IDE experience #78627

Closed

  • Indexers lack support for `NotNullIfNotNull` attribute #78623
  • Quick Info in VS Code is not displaying type arguments in some cases #77233
  • The .NET Framework build task deployed to .NET SDK needs a different identity #78565
    Next
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10616.19 #78622

PullRequests

Created

  • Convert operand of `true`/`false` operator invoked as part of `&&`/`||`operator evaluation #78629
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: disallow indexers #78626
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Extensions: rename syntax node #78625
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #78624
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Support consumption of binary extension operators #78594
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix angle brackets in generics in hover #78621
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Give .NET Framework build task in sdk different identity #78584
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Namespace changes #78620
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Support local functions in outline/breadcrumbs #78605
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Backport copilot text change analysis to 17.14 #78498
    Area-IDE, untriaged, VSCode
